selection_protocol: Choose the best 2023 proper score among candidates that pass 2024 and 2025 probability checks. Later seasons participated in acceptance and are development checks, not untouched tests.

cfb_expansion.protocol: Additional development selection after a 120-candidate expanded CFB search. Require both proper scores no worse than the existing accepted CFB totals layer in both 2024 and 2025, then choose by 2023 log loss/Brier. These years are not untouched tests. No historical quote freshness, price or injury-scenario ledger exists.

current_NFL_2026.basis: Dated prior-week reconstruction through the saved quote cutoff; closing references, not a frozen live pick ledger
